label: Vignette Spot
description: A soft radial ELLIPSE wash centered in its box -- the editorial 'category card' backdrop: a dark ellipse hole on a cream canvas with a colored headline sitting inside it (pair with kinetic-text on top), or a light halo behind a hero on a dark canvas. Backdrop dressing only, never text. Example: { color: 'rgba(20,22,30,0.92)', reach: 62 } under a bold colored headline.

color.label: Ellipse color (default rgba(20,22,30,0.92) -- a dark hole)

reach.label: Ellipse radius as % of the box (default 62)
